orders.text:
CRLR No. 181 of 2019 
With 
CLMA No. 886 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Heard. 
 Admit the revision. 
 Issue notice to the respondent fixing 
13.06.2019. 
 Steps be taken within a week. 
 Also heard on stay application. 
 Having considered the submission of 
learned counsel for the parties, as an 
interim measure, it is directed that till the 
next date of listing, the effect and operation 
of impugned order dated 17.01.2019 shall 
remain stayed provided revisionist pays a 
sum of Rs.7,000/- per month to the 
respondent. Stay application stands 
disposed of accordingly. 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 03.05.2019 Mamta

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 181 of 2019
With
CRMA No. 2760 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. Kanti Ram Sharma, Advocate on 
behalf of Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the 
respondent. 
The Amendment Application No. 2760 
of 2019 filed by the revisionist is formal in 
nature. The same is allowed. 
The revisionist is directed to make 
necessary amendment within a period of one 
week from today. 
List this Criminal Revision on 16th
December, 2019. 
The parties to the Revision are directed 
to appear in person for making an effort for 
mediation on 16th December, 2019. 
The counsel for the parties are directed 
to inform their respective clients to ensure 
their appearance on 16th December, 2019. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 07.12.2019
Shiv

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CRLR No. 181 of 2019
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. B.M. Pingal, Advocate for the 
revisionist.
Mr. Pawan Mishra, Advocate for the 
respondent.
The parties were directed to appear in 
person for making an effort for mediation. 
Mr. Pawan Mishra, learned counsel for the 
respondent submits that he has already 
conveyed the inability of the respondent to 
appear in the proceedings fixed for today, and 
hence he prays for that some another date 
may be fixed.
As per the consent of the counsels, the 
matter is directed to be posted on 06.01.2020. 
The parties are directed to appear in person.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
16.12.2019 Mahinder/
